posts.title: The Perils of Web Development
posts.description: Earlier this year, I wrote a couple of times about my utility closet of infinite WTFs . After a total remodel and HVAC upgrade, I learned the demons had not been exorcised . Indeed, they still haunt the place, and now they're really showing off their sense of humor. On a recent November morning with frost covering the ground and below-freezing temps, I awoke to find my house a chilly 14.4C / 58F.
